children.name: finalNewline

children.name: maxAnywhereInFile
children.doc: maximum consecutive empty lines anywhere in file - runs last, all empty lines policies are limited to "maxAnywhereInFile"

children.name: beforePackage

children.name: afterPackage
children.doc: empty lines after package declaration

children.name: importAndUsing

children.name: afterLeftCurly
children.doc: Remove or keep empty lines below "{"

children.name: afterReturn
children.doc: Remove or keep empty lines below "return"

children.name: beforeDocCommentEmptyLines
children.doc:
"one" adds one empty line above doc comments
"none" removes all empty lines above doc comments
"ignore" respects empty lines set via "betweenVars", "betweenFunctions", etc.

children.name: afterFieldsWithDocComments
children.doc:
"one" adds one empty line after fields with doc comments
"none" removes all empty lines line fields with doc comments
"ignore" respects empty lines set via "betweenVars", "betweenFunctions", etc.

children.name: afterFileHeaderComment
children.doc: Adds empty lines when file starts with a multiline comment

children.name: betweenMultilineComments
children.doc: Adds empty lines between two consecutive multiline comments

children.name: beginType
children.doc: add empty lines after opening "{" of type

children.name: endType

children.name: beginType
children.doc: add empty lines after opening "{" of type

children.name: endType
children.doc: add empty lines before closing "}" of type

children.name: betweenImports
children.doc: empty lines between two consecutive import/using lines using betweenImportsLevel

children.name: betweenImportsLevel
children.doc:
restrict betweenImports setting to a specific level
"all" - apply betweenImports to all imports/using entries
"firstLevelPackage" - group imports/using entries using toplevel package names; no empty lines for identical toplevel names
"secondLevelPackage" - group imports/using entries using top- and secondlevel package names; no empty lines for identical toplevel and secondlevel names
"thirdLevelPackage" - group imports/using entries using upto thirdlevel package names
"fourthLevelPackage" - group imports/using entries using upto foruthlevel package names
"fifthLevelPackage" - group imports/using entries using upto fifthlevel package names
"fullPackage" - group imports/using entries using full packages; no empty lines for identical package names

children.name: beforeUsing
children.doc: empty lines between import and using lines

children.name: beforeType
children.doc: empty lines after import and using section

children.name: disableFormatting
children.doc:
turns off formatting for all files in current folder and subfolders
unless subfolder contains a `hxformat.json`

children.name: excludes
children.doc:
regular expressions matching files to exclude from formatting
default is to exclude any `.haxelib`, `.git` and `node_modules` folder

children.name: conditionalPolicy
children.doc:
only applies to non inlined conditionals
"fixedZero" = all conditional statements should start in column 1
"fixedZeroIncrease" = indentation for conditionals starts at 0 and increases for every level
"fixedZeroIncreaseBlocks" = same as "fixedZeroIncrease" but increases only inside blocks, outside it's "fixedZero"
"aligned" = conditional statements share indentation of surrounding code
"alignedNestedIncrease" = conditionals align with surrounding code, but will increase indent when nested
"alignedIncrease" = same as "aligned" but will increase indent by +1 for enclosed code
"alignedDecrease" = same as "aligned" but will decrease indent by -1 for enclosed code

children.name: character
children.doc: use "tab", " ", "  ", "   ", "    ", etc. to define which character to use

children.name: tabWidth
children.doc: if `character` is set to "tab", formatter uses `tabWidth` to calculate absolute line length

children.name: trailingWhitespace
children.doc: adds trailing whitespace to empty lines by copying indentation from preceeding line

children.name: indentComplexValueExpressions
indentCaseLabels
children.doc: indent case / default labels (true) or keep them on same level as switch (false)

children.name: lineEndCharacter
children.doc: line end character to use when outputting formatted code

children.name: leftCurly

children.name: rightCurly
children.doc: global right curly line end setting

children.name: emptyCurly
children.doc: global empty curlies line end setting

children.name: blockCurly

children.name: anonFunctionCurly

children.name: anonTypeCurly
children.doc: line end settings for anon type curlies

children.name: objectLiteralCurly

children.name: emptyCurly
children.doc: line end options for empty curlies

children.name: Auto
children.doc: detect line end character from input (repeated for each input file)

children.name: CR
children.doc: output files with \r line endings

children.name: LF
children.doc: output files with \n line endings

children.name: CRLF
children.doc: output files with \r\n line endings

children.name: ifBody
children.doc:
same line policy for non block body of "if"
same = place if and body on same line
next = place body on next line
keep = keep same / next line from source

children.name: elseBody
children.doc:
same line policy for non block body of "else"
same = place else and body on same line
next = place body on next line
keep = keep same / next line from source

children.name: ifElse
children.doc:
same line policy for "else" part of "if…else"
same = place else and body on same line
next = place body on next line
keep = keep same / next line from source

children.name: ifElseSemicolonNextLine
children.doc:
Add new line after `if body` to `if (...) body; else ...`
Don't touch `if (...) body else ...` or `if (...) {body} else ...`

children.name: elseIf
children.doc:
same line policy for "if" part of "else if"
same = place if and body on same line
next = place body on next line
keep = keep same / next line from source

children.name: expressionIf
children.doc:
same line policy for non block body of "if" in a value place / as expression
same = place if and body on same line
next = place body on next line
keep = keep same / next line from source

children.name: expressionIfWithBlocks
children.doc:
will place if with one expression in a block in one line (requires "expressionIf" = "same")
var foo = if (bar) { ""; } else { ""; };

children.name: forBody
children.doc:
same line policy for non block body of "for"
same = place function and body on same line
next = place body on next line
keep = keep same / next line from source

children.name: whileBody
children.doc:
same line policy for non block body of "while" (not "do…while")
same = place while and body on same line
next = place body on next line
keep = keep same / next line from source

children.name: doWhileBody
children.doc:
same line policy for non block body of "do…while"
same = place function and body on same line
next = place body on next line
keep = keep same / next line from source

children.name: doWhile
children.doc:
same line policy for "while" part in "do…while"
same = place while and body on same line
next = place body on next line
keep = keep same / next line from source

children.name: tryBody
children.doc:
same line policy for non block body of "try"
same = place try and body on same line
next = place body on next line
keep = keep same / next line from source

children.name: catchBody
children.doc:
same line policy for non block body of "catch"
same = place catch and body on same line
next = place body on next line
keep = keep same / next line from source

children.name: tryCatch
children.doc:
same line policy for "catch" part of "try…catch"
same = place function and body on same line
next = place body on next line
keep = keep same / next line from source

children.name: functionBody
children.doc:
same line policy for non block body of "function"
same = place function and body on same line
next = place body on next line
keep = keep same / next line from source

children.name: anonFunctionBody
children.doc:
same line policy for non block body of anon "function"
same = place function and body on same line
next = place body on next line
keep = keep same / next line from source

children.name: returnBody
children.doc:
same line policy for multiline expression return values
same = place return and body on same line
next = place body on next line
keep = keep same / next line from source

children.name: returnBodySingleLine
children.doc:
same line policy for single line expression return values
same = place return and body on same line
next = place body on next line
keep = keep same / next line from source

children.name: untypedBody
children.doc:
same line policy for untyped {…} as a body
same = place return and body on same line
next = place body on next line
keep = keep same / next line from source

children.name: compressSuccessiveParenthesis
children.doc: should formatter compress spaces for successive parenthesis `( [ {` vs. `([{`

children.name: formatStringInterpolation
children.doc:
should formatter try to format string interpolation expressions (e.g. '${x+3}' -> '${x + 3}')
only applies spaces, no newlines or wrapping

children.doc: parens used for if conditions

children.doc: parens used for switch conditions

children.name: whileConditionParens
children.doc: parens used for while conditions

children.name: sharpConditionParens
children.doc: parens used for sharp conditions

children.name: catchParens
children.doc: parens used for catch

children.name: forLoopParens
children.doc: parens used for for loops

children.name: expressionParens
children.doc: parens used for expressions

children.doc: braces for blocks

children.doc: braces for anon types

children.doc: braces for object literals

children.doc: maximum characters per line, formatter will try to wrap code longer than `maxLineLength`

children.doc:
array wrapping rules
does not affect array comprehension, use "sameLine.comprehensionFor"

children.name: mapWrap
children.doc:
map literal wrapping rules
does not affect map comprehension, use "sameLine.comprehensionFor"

children.name: arrayMatrixWrap
children.doc:
detect arrays in matrix configuration from source
noMatrixWrap = no detection
matrixWrapNoAlign = detect and format as matrix without alignment
matrixWrapWithAlign = detect and format as matrix and align columns

children.name: typeParameter
children.doc: type parameter wrapping rules

children.name: functionSignature
children.doc: named function signature wrapping rules

children.name: anonFunctionSignature
children.doc: anon function signature wrapping rules

children.doc: call parameter wrapping rules

children.name: metadataCallParameter
children.doc: metadata call parameter wrapping rules

children.name: objectLiteral
children.doc: object literal wrapping rules

children.name: anonType
children.doc: anon types wrapping rules

children.name: methodChain
children.doc: method chaining wrapping rules

children.name: opBoolChain
children.doc: OpBool chain wrapping rules

children.name: implementsExtends
children.doc: implements / extends chain wrapping rules

children.name: opAddSubChain
children.doc: chain wrapping rules for OpAdd / OpSub

children.name: multiVar
children.doc: chain wrapping rules for OpAdd / OpSub

children.name: casePattern
children.doc: chain wrapping rules for case patterns

children.name: rules
children.doc:
list of wrapping rules
wrapping uses only the first rule whose conditions evaluates to true

children.name: defaultWrap
children.doc: default wrapping type when no rule applies

children.name: defaultLocation
children.doc: default wrapping location before / after last token

children.name: defaultAdditionalIndent
children.doc: adds indentation to all wrapped lines when applying defaultWrap

children.name: conditions
children.doc:
list of conditions
wrapping selects a rule if all of its conditions evaluate to true

children.name: type
children.doc: wrapping type

children.name: location
children.doc: default wrapping location before / after last token

children.name: additionalIndent
children.doc: adds indentation to all wrapped lines

children.name: OnePerLine
children.doc: every item in a separate line, including first item

children.name: OnePerLineAfterFirst
children.doc: every item in a separate line, except first item

children.name: EqualNumber
children.doc: put an equal amount of items per line - not yet implemented

children.name: FillLine
children.doc: fill each line until maxLineLength - does not start with a newline

children.name: FillLineWithLeadingBreak
children.doc: fill each line until maxLineLength, starts with a newline before first item

children.name: NoWrap
children.doc: do not wrap items

children.name: Keep
children.doc: use wrapping information from source

children.name: ItemCountLargerThan
children.doc: condition matches if item count is larger than or equal n items

children.name: ItemCountLessThan
children.doc: condition matches if item count is less than or equal n items

children.name: AnyItemLengthLargerThan
children.doc: condition matches if max item length is larger than or equal n characters

children.name: AllItemLengthsLessThan
children.doc: condition matches if max item length is less than or equal n characters

children.name: AllItemLengthsLargerThan
children.doc: condition matches if min item length is larger than or equal n characters

children.name: AnyItemLengthLessThan
children.doc: condition matches if min item length is less than or equal n characters

children.name: TotalItemLengthLargerThan
children.doc: condition matches if total length of all wrapable items is larger than or equal n characters

children.name: TotalItemLengthLessThan
children.doc: condition matches if total length of all wrapable items is less than or equal n characters

children.name: LineLengthLargerThan
children.doc: condition matches lines larger than or equal n characters

children.name: LineLengthLessThan
children.doc: condition matches lines less than or equal n characters

children.name: HasMultiLineItems
children.doc:
condition value = 1 matches if line contains a multiline token (string literal, block comment)
value = 0 matches if no multiline token is present

children.name: ExceedsMaxLineLength
children.doc:
condition value = 1 matches if unwrapped line exceeds maxLineLength
value = 0 matches unwrapped lines not exceeding maxLineLength

children.name: EqualItemLengths
children.doc:
condition value = 1 matches if all items have identical item length
value = 0 matches any two items having different item lengths

children.name: loadConfig
children.doc:
Determines the config to be used for a particular `path` (either a directory or a file),
based on the `hxformat.json` that is closest to it.

If there is no `hxformat.json`, `null` is returned.
